The minimum specifications are for editing HD video. The recommended specifications are for editing video in HD, 4K, or higher resolutions.

Windows

Requirement type / Minimum specification / Recommended specification

Processor
Minimum: Intel 6th Generation or newer CPU - or AMD Ryzen 1000 Series or newer CPU. Advanced Vector Extensions 2 (AVX2) Support required. Windows on Arm: Qualcomm Snapdragon X series processor
Recommended: Intel 11th Gen or newer CPU with Quick Sync - or AMD Ryzen 3000 Series / Threadripper 3000 series or newer CPU. Windows on Arm: Qualcomm Snapdragon X series processor

Operating system
Minimum: Windows 11 v24H2. Windows on Arm: Windows 11 v24H2 (OS Build 26100.2033)
Recommended: Windows 11 v24H2

Memory
Minimum: 8 GB RAM. Windows on Arm: 16 GB
Recommended: 16 GB RAM for HD media. 32 GB or more for 4K and higher

GPU
Minimum: Windows with NVIDIA GPU: GPU must be of the Maxwell generation (2014) or newer and have at least 4GB of GPU memory. Windows with Intel or AMD GPU with at least 4GB of GPU memory. Windows on Arm: Qualcomm Adreno GPU driver 31.0.121.1
Recommended: 8 GB GPU memory

Storage
Minimum: 8 GB of available hard disk space, plus additional free space during installation. Note that it cannot be installed on removable flash storage. Additional high-speed drive for media
Recommended: Fast internal SSD for app installation and cache. Additional high-speed drive for media

Display
Minimum: 1920x1080 pixels
Recommended: 1920x1080 pixels or more. DisplayHDR 1000 for HDR workflows

Sound card
Minimum: ASIO compatible or Microsoft Windows Driver Model
Recommended: ASIO compatible or Microsoft Windows Driver Model

Network storage connection
Minimum: 1 Gigabit Ethernet (HD only)
Recommended: 1 Gigabit Ethernet (HD only). 10 Gigabit Ethernet for 4K shared network workflow

Deutsch, English, Espanol, Francais, Italiano, Portugues (Brasil), Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
